name: Justified Lightbox Gallery
description: Justified-row photo gallery where images fill each row at equal height, with a dim and zoom hover effect and a fullscreen lightbox with keyboard and button navigation.
contents: Flexible justified grid of 28 landscape images
Fullscreen lightbox with caption, counter, close and previous/next buttons
behavior: Images fade in once loaded and lazy load
Hover or focus brightens and zooms the image and shows an accent border
Click, Enter or Space opens the lightbox; Escape closes, arrow keys navigate with wraparound
Page scroll is locked while the lightbox is open
Below 480px the grid becomes a single column
editableByProps: Row height, gap, background class and accent color
Toggle dimmed resting state of images

needsCodeEdit.change: Change lightbox backdrop color or animation
needsCodeEdit.where: Modal function root div and the fadeIn and slideUp keyframes
max-[480px] classes on the ul and li elements

fixed: Sets document body overflow to hidden while the lightbox is open and resets it on close and unmount
Lightbox listens for keydown on window while open
